name: nvke
description: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine (NVKE). A management plane for GPU Kubernetes on bare metal.
one_liner: A management tool that lets a company run its own private 'cloud' of Kubernetes clusters on its own NVIDIA GPU machines, instead of renting GPUs from a big cloud provider.
buyer: An IT director at a mid-size company that already owns GPU hardware for AI workloads and wants to carve it up like an internal cloud for different teams.
business_use_cases: A GPU colocation or bare-metal hosting provider uses it to offer a 'private GPU cloud' to AI startups that don't want to depend on big cloud vendors.
A platform-engineering consultancy installs and manages it for enterprise clients building internal AI infrastructure, billed as a retainer.
A hardware reseller bundles NVKE setup and support as a packaged 'GPU Kubernetes in a box' offering for companies buying their own GPU racks.

money_ideas.idea: Managed installation and support retainer for enterprise GPU clusters
One-off installation project for a client's GPU hardware

steal_this: This is preview-stage enterprise infrastructure, not weekend-buildable — the realistic move is a platform-engineering freelancer offering a paid pilot install on a client's existing GPU cluster.
